$comment: Sample-app stream catalogue. See README.md in this directory for the schema contract.

rails.title: Big Buck Bunny
rails.note: The same film across delivery formats and codecs. No clean public Widevine or FairPlay Big Buck Bunny stream exists — every one is clear except Microsoft's PlayReady-only asset — so general DRM is demonstrated on the Streams rail instead.

items.title: Adaptive
items.label: Big Buck Bunny · HLS (adaptive, up to 1080p)
items.note: All-avc1 master, so it plays on every engine including iOS.

items.title: Adaptive
items.label: Big Buck Bunny · DASH · 4K (H.264, up to 2160p)
items.note: Genuine 3840x2160 H.264 ladder — verified, unlike many listings that label 1080p as 4K. Android and web only; AVPlayer has no DASH.

items.title: Progressive
items.label: Big Buck Bunny · MP4 (progressive, 360p)
items.note: MimeType.MP4 routes this to the native <video> element on web. The old commondatastorage.googleapis.com BBB mp4 is now 403 — do not use it.

items.title: AV1
items.label: Big Buck Bunny · AV1 (MP4, progressive)
items.note: Chrome and Android decode AV1; iOS and Safari surface a graceful codec error.

items.title: PlayReady
items.label: Big Buck Bunny · DASH · PlayReady DRM
items.note: The only DRM-protected Big Buck Bunny asset that exists. PlayReady decrypts only on Edge/Windows and PlayReady-capable Android; everywhere else this surfaces a clean DRM error, which is itself worth demonstrating.

rails.title: BBC Test Card
rails.note: The same one-hour reference content as VOD and as a simulcast, across DASH and HLS, AVC and HEVC. iOS cannot play any of these: the test card's HLS uses in-band parameter sets (avc3), and AVPlayer has no DASH.

items.title: 4K UHD
items.label: Tears of Steel · 4K UHD · HLS (H.264, all engines)
items.note: The rare 4K that plays everywhere: UHD H.264 over HLS. Most 4K ships as HEVC, VP9 or AV1, which no single engine set can all decode.

items.title: VP9
items.label: Tears of Steel · VP9 · DASH
items.note: Chrome and Android only; iOS has neither DASH nor VP9, Safari has no VP9.

items.title: Widevine
items.label: Tears of Steel · Widevine DRM · DASH

items.title: Dolby Vision
items.label: Dolby Vision HDR · HLS
items.note: Profile-5 over HLS specifically so iOS can play it. Dolby Vision is HEVC-based: Safari, iOS and DV-capable Android with an HDR display; Chrome surfaces a codec error. True HDR that also plays on Chrome would need VP9-HDR, AV1-HDR or HDR10.

items.title: FairPlay
items.label: FairPlay DRM · HLS
items.note: FairPlay requires certificateUrl; without it the key session cannot start.

rails.title: Ads
rails.note: Server-side insertion is app-driven: no engine reads AdConfig.ServerSide, the stitched stream plays unchanged and the app feeds an AdController. Client-side insertion runs inside the engine on Android and Web only.

items.title: SCTE-35 (live)
items.label: Unified Streaming · live SCTE-35 ad signalling
items.note: A real broadcast signal carrying recurring avails roughly every 120 seconds, CORS-enabled. The poller reads genuine cue-points from the manifest rather than simulating them.

items.title: CSAI · IMA
items.label: Big Buck Bunny · IMA client-side ads
items.note: Google's canonical single-inline-linear VAST pre-roll. IMA renders its own skip and countdown UI. Android and Web only; iOS has the bridge but no adapter ships.

items.title: SSAI Ads
items.label: Big Buck Bunny · SSAI cue-points (simulated)
items.note: Cue-points are simulated. A real integration parses them from a MediaTailor tracking response or from SCTE-35, both of which have parsers in :core.
